name: onomeo
description: Chat front-end with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and a site-wide free-call pool.
overview: onomeo runs a chat site and exposes the same models through https://onomeo.com/v1, OpenAI-compatible. Free usage is a site-wide pool of free-model calls refreshed every five hours and shared by every account, shown on the models page as a percentage left; the API returns account_quota (403) once your share is spent and network_quota or site_busy (429) when the shared pool is under load. The separately suffixed free model ids that older directories listed are gone — the 44-model catalogue now prices every named model — so the free pool is the only no-top-up route. Paid models such as Claude and GPT need a balance.

offer.label: Free-model calls from a shared pool

notes: The free pool is shared across all accounts, so the percentage shown is the whole service's remainder, not yours. Update: on 2026-11-18 the models page no longer carries the separately suffixed free ids, only the shared pool.
